title: AME PHYSICAL EXAMINATION INFORMATION AND DISPOSITION TABLES

blocks.text:
- Click any of the following Aerospace Medical Disposition Tables to access the most common conditions of aeromedical significance, and course of action that should be taken by the AME.
- The tables are not all-inclusive.
- For any Condition Not Listed , see that page for general guidance.
- Do NOT issue a medical certificate without first consulting AMCD or RFS if: - The condition requires deferral per the tables, or - The condition is not listed and may cause subtle or sudden incapacitation.
